notes.title: Notifications of game price updates
notes.notes: [p]At the request of the partners, all historical free-to-play games under the production team will be converted to paid games.[/p][p]Free games that were already active are not affected and you can continue to play normally.[/p]

notes.title: This game will be transformed into a free game
notes.notes:
Hello,

My friends,

Due to the need for later support of the game, the main body of the game will be converted into a free game;

This transition will not have any impact on the game content of users who have already purchased it.

More level updates will be launched in the future, thank you.
